editorialNarrative.synopsis: Nikola Bartunkova / Camila Osorio and Lyudmyla Kichenok / Nadiia Kichenok meet at the first elimination point of the Women's doubles path. Alexander Zverev now heads a men's draw whose five former champions all sit in the bottom half, including returning defending champion Carlos Alcaraz. In the women's event, Aryna Sabalenka is chasing a third straight title; alongside that individual history sits the longer American men's drought, unbroken since Andy Roddick in 2003.
